skills.name: Chilling
skills.description: Gives beneficial effects to nearby allies by entertaining them with its cute behavior.  *Skill Evade Rate +30% (10 sec) *Skill Use Rate +30%  (10 sec)

skills.name: Up and Up
skills.description: Moon is thrown up high toward the enemies and attacks them. *Cancels enemy invincibility skills  *Stuns enemies (5 sec) *Changes Light elemental enemies to None (5 sec) *Applies charm effect to 1 enemies within range. (12 sec)

abilities.name: Same Fate
abilities.description: When the Ranger is defeated, it will randomly take 1 of the enemies with it. It has a certain chance of activating in PVP and Guild War, and a lower chance in other battles. (Bosses and Guardians will not be affected by this Ability)

abilities.name: Mineral Mooch
abilities.description: Steal the opposing team's minerals, slowing their production. (Production is slowed by per Ranger with this Ability that joins the battle)
